THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:

ORDER Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent Nos.1 and2.
2.

It is noticed that the petitioner had approached this Court, seeking similar relief by filing WP No.101116 of 2020, which was considered by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court and disposed of vide order dated 29.09.2021, granting the following relief:
  "Petition is hereby allowed.
The impugned original award dated  18.4.2011 at Annexure- E and supplementary award dated 8 .1. 2014 at Annexure- A are hereby quashed.
The respondent No.2 -SLAO is directed to pass a new and fresh composite award in respect of the subject land as well as malkies in accordance with law as expeditiously as possible.

It is further directed that out of the compensation payable in favour of the petitioner under the new and fresh NC: 2024:KHC-D:5252 composite award, there would be set- off/deduction of the amount already received by the petitioners pursuant to the original award dated 18.4.2011 .
All rival contentions on merit are kept open and no opinion is expressed on the same.

The petitioners are directed to withdraw Misc. No.28/2014 filed by them on the file of the Principal Civil Judge (
Sr.Dn), Hubli as expeditiously as possible.

It is further directed that after respondent  No.2-SLAO passes a new and fresh Srim Gurudutta S/O K V Jayaram vs The Karnataka Industrial Area ... on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120870199/
2 composite award as directed in this order, liberty is reserved in favour of the parties to take recourse to such remedies as available in law."
3.

sentences.text: In spite of the above learned counsel for respondent Nos.1 and 2 submits that the representation submitted by the petitioners is still under consideration.
However, he submits that the same will be considered without further loss of time.
4. It is noticed that the earlier writ petition was allowed vide order dated 29.09.2021.
More than two and a half years have already lapsed after directing respondent Nos. 2 and 3 to consider their representation.

In view of the above, the petition is allowed, reiterating the directions issued vide order dated 29.09.2021, passed in WP No.101116 of 2020, directing respondent No.2 SLAO to pass a fresh composite award within a period of 30 days from the date of receipt of the order, failing which the petitioners are entitled to take further steps in this regard.
